native_mechanisms: One fold per mark, each fold's angle determined jointly by the mark and the crease left by the previous fold (state-carrying sequential accumulation).

Every crease checked against all four wire birds' beaks simultaneously, refolding tighter until all four gauges agree and the spiral/shell markings deliberately misalign (multi-gauge consensus with corrective re-folding and enforced asymmetry).

Thin the whole folded wad at the water's edge into one small dense coin, carrying only the suitcase, and destroy every scrap, trimming and failed gauge reading (irreversible compression to a fixed-size digest plus discard of all intermediate state).
core_technique: A near-verbatim xxHash64: four interleaved 64-bit lanes of add-multiply-rotate-multiply rounds over 32-byte stripes (unrolled to 64 bytes with prefetch), rotate-and-sum lane convergence plus asymmetric merge rounds, length addition, 8/4/1-byte tail folding, and a standard xor-shift/multiply final avalanche.
